name: digital-date
description: A digital date widget that shows your system date without the time component.

config.name: format
config.label: Format
config.description: The order in which day, month, and year are displayed (e.g. DMY for day-month-year).

config.name: separator
config.label: Separator
config.description: The character used to separate the day, month, and year values.

config.name: text_color
config.label: Text Color
config.description: The color of the date text.

config.name: font_family
config.label: Font
config.description: The font family used to render the date text.

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the date text in pixels.

config.name: align_horizontal
config.label: Align Horizontal
config.description: Controls the horizontal alignment of the date within the widget.

config.name: align_vertical
config.label: Align Vertical
config.description: Controls the vertical alignment of the date within the widget.
